rules.note: Valid for more than 1.5 years, with two blank visa pages.
Passport-size, clear, white background.
Notarised copies of your bachelor's and master's degrees.
Notarised final transcripts or marks sheets of your bachelor's and master's.
An English proficiency letter.
Two recommendation letters.
Study plan or personal statement, 800 to 1,000 words.
The physical examination form.
Your resume.
Any experience letter, if you have one.
A police no criminal record certificate.
Your thesis, research articles or research papers, if you have any.
